Carlos (AE): Heads up — GreenRiver Capital dropped a CAIQ + a short bespoke security spreadsheet. They want everything back before next Tue COB.
IntakeBot: New upload: greenriver_caiq_2026.pdf (1.9 MB), greenriver_custom_questions.xlsx
Tess (Sales): @Ravi can you own triage? Customer is sensitive about data residency, encryption, and contract addenda for Dedicated.
Ravi (Security): On it. First pass: CAIQ mostly maps to our standard answers, but we need to confirm encryption key ownership, and whether logs contain PII.
Carlos (AE): PoC plan: hosted in us-west, then potentially Dedicated APAC region later. They explicitly asked for proof of key management and evidence of SOC2 scope.
Nora (SE): For PoC we can enable regional routing to us-west. If they need Dedicated APAC later, that will be a separate deployment. I'll note ops steps in the runbook.
Ravi (Security): Please upload sample logs (redacted) so I can confirm PII patterns. Also need the KMS key policy and export showing key wrapping.
Carlos (AE): Uploaded redacted logs: https://drive.redwood/greenriver/logs_redacted.tsv
Nora (SE): KMS policy snippet (internal) is here: https://redwood.internal/sec/kms_policy_snippets.md
Ravi (Security): Thanks. Early flags: (1) Hosted model inference: customer asks for "customer-managed keys"  we currently support KMS-backed keys managed by Redwood; customer-managed KMS is available only in Private/Dedicated for on-prem or VPC. Marked as "requires contract / product discussion". (2) Data retention: we have token retention controls; need to confirm they meet the spreadsheet TTLs.
Tess (Sales): Do we have a standard reply about customer-managed keys? I can share that in the RFP response.
Sam (Legal): We have a standard DPA clause and an addendum for Dedicated/private key ownership. I'll prepare draft language but need product sign-off to confirm feasibility.
Nora (SE): Technical note for Sales: for Dedicated/Private KMS customer-managed keys we support BYOK via external KMS or HSM integration. Example command for audit export: 
```
aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id alias/redwood-fleet-key
```
Nora (SE): Also attaching PoC config sample for short retention + ephemeral tokens:
```
service:
  region: us-west-2
  inference:
    token_retention_days: 1
    ephemeral_sessions: true
    logging: redact_user_messages: true
```
Ravi (Security): I'm updating the CAIQ mapping sheet with answers and evidence links. A few questions are "partial" because they depend on Dedicated deployment.
Carlos (AE): Customer also asked about custom pen tests. Thoughts?
Ravi (Security): We run annual third-party pentests; custom per-customer tests require SOW and work with infra. Flagged as "legal + sales decision".
Sam (Legal): I'll draft SOW language options and non-prod test boundaries. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Tess (Sales): Timeline check: AO wants us to deliver completed CAIQ + custom answers by Tue. With Legal + Security + SE alignment, is that realistic?
Ravi (Security): Realistic if we get KMS policy and confirm retention configs today. I'll prioritize.
Nora (SE): I'll verify token TTL config and confirm logging redaction within next 4 hours.
Carlos (AE): I'll tell the customer we're reviewing and will deliver by Tue COB, pending Legal sign-off.
Ravi (Security): Status: assigned to Ravi, in-review. Action items logged in shared sheet: evidence links requested, KMS policy, redacted logs, Legal DPA draft. Target close ts: 1800000123.
Sam (Legal): Noted. I'll ping when the DPA draft is uploaded.
Carlos (AE): Thanks all — please ping here when items are uploaded so I can consolidate the response. :pray:
